responsibility: Implements the main target backend logic for RL78 outside the declarative md files. This file owns target hooks, per-function machine state, the custom devirtualization and move-elimination RTL passes, prologue/epilogue and frame handling helpers, address-space and addressing validation, assembler output helpers, section and constructor/destructor handling, compare-flag reuse logic, libcall emission helpers, and instruction-formatting routines such as addsi expansion support, tying together option state, md patterns, and final assembly generation for the RL78 port.
same_name_distinction: Contains the imperative C++ implementation of the RL78 backend behavior that the other same-stem files declare or describe: it defines target-hook functions, helper routines, backend passes, and asm-output logic used by the port, whereas rl78.h provides the macro/config interface, rl78.md provides declarative RTL machine-description patterns, and rl78.opt defines command-line options.
